title: The data of the proof: the parameters N₀ and d, the CM field E = K(ζ) and its places, the scales x, x₁, b, the ranks m, k, r, t, the order a, the comparison of sizes on the logarithmic scale, and the existence of admissible data at every large x
summary: Parameters are a multiple N₀ of 18480 and a prime d ≡ N₀/2 − 1 mod N₀; they give K = ℚ(√−d) and, for every exponent s, the CM field E = K(ζ), ζ a primitive root of unity of order N₁ = N₀·3^c·2^s, whose infinite places form a group identified with Gal(E/K) and with (ℤ/N₁)^×; the unit proves the dictionary between places, Galois elements, residue classes and Frobenius elements, the different of E (generated by a purely imaginary ϖ_E whose product over the places is a power of the root discriminant) and the Weil data of E. Admissible data over the parameters are three scales log b ≪ x ≪ x₁ ≪ b stored by their logarithms, ranks m ≈ √x (a power of 2) and r ≈ x⁵ (a power of 3), a set of thick places free of three-term relations, two primes g₀ ≠ g₁ ≡ 1 with an integer of K of norm g₀g₁, and primes ≡ 1 mod M_ω² in every short window; from them the unit names k = r + 1 − m, t = 5r, the order a, the weights, the prime sum, the budget and the cost of one direction, and builds the class HasLogBound by which instance search compares monomials in the scales (`le_of_hasLogBound`). The last result, `exists_data`, says that for 0 < ε < 1/100 admissible data with scale x, log x₁ = x^(ε/6) and log log b = ε log x exist for every large x.

members.name: Parameters.c
members.statement_lean: def Parameters.c P := (exists_isJetConjugate_generator P).choose + (2 * P.d + 6) +
members.text: Definition. For parameters P, c(P) is the real number C + (2·d(P) + 6) + (N₀(P) + |chowlaSelbergConst(d(P))| + Σ_ξ |log ‖Φ′_{N₀(P)}(ξ)‖|), where C is the natural number chosen (by `Classical.choose`) from `Parameters.exists_isJetConjugate_generator P`, the sum runs over the primitive N₀(P)-th roots of unity ξ in ℂ, Φ_{N₀(P)} is the N₀(P)-th cyclotomic polynomial over ℂ and Φ′_{N₀(P)} its derivative, and chowlaSelbergConst(d(P)) = γ − Re L′/L(1, χ_K) (γ Euler's constant). Every summand is nonnegative, so c(P) is at least each of them; the development uses c(P) to bound 64, N₀(P), d(P) and φ(N₀(P)) (`Data.c_ge`, Magnitudes.lean 21–22), |chowlaSelbergConst(d(P))| (ShortAndEnough.lean 76) and the chosen constant C (New/Curve/ConjugatesOfJets.lean 169–198), and admissible data make it negligible against their scales (their field `scale` asks 10¹²·c(P) ≤ log log b(D)). (The source's gloss, New/Main.lean 91, that c(P) 'bounds what depends on N₀, d only' is not a statement: c(P) + 1 also depends on N₀(P) and d(P) only.)

members.name: Data
members.statement_lean: structure Data (P : Parameters) where
members.text: Structure. Admissible data D over parameters P consist of: real numbers logX(D), logB(D), logX₁(D) (the logarithms of the scales x, b, x₁); natural numbers s(D), m(D), r(D); a finite set thick(D) of infinite places of E(P, s(D)); a function g(D) : {0, 1} → ℕ; an integer piG(D) of K = ℚ(√−d(P)); and proofs of: (s_le) s ≤ 32·logX (writing s, logX, … for the fields s(D), logX(D), … being listed); (scale) 10¹²·c(P) ≤ log logB, 100·log logB ≤ logX, 10⁶·logX ≤ logX₁, 10⁶·logX₁ ≤ logB and 6·log logX₁ ≤ log logB, that is, with x = e^{logX}, x₁ = e^{logX₁}, b = e^{logB}: (log b)¹⁰⁰ ≤ x, x^{10⁶} ≤ x₁, x₁^{10⁶} ≤ b, (log x₁)⁶ ≤ log b and 10¹²·c(P) ≤ log log b; (m_mem) e^{logX/2} ≤ m ≤ 2·e^{logX/2}; (r_mem) e^{5 logX} ≤ r ≤ 3·e^{5 logX}; (m_pow) there is a natural number e with m = 2^{e+1} and s = 22(e + 1) (so 2^s = m²²); (r_pow) there is a natural number e with r = 3^{e+1}; (thick_eq_neg_one_mod) for every natural number m′ and every proof h of m′ ∣ N₁(P, s): if m′ divides N₀(P)·3^{⌊log₃ s⌋+5}, then placeClass(P, h)(σ) = −1 in (ℤ/m′)^× for every σ ∈ thick (the Lean binder is named m and hides the field m); (three_term) with φ = placeClass(P, h₂) the reduction Φ(P, s) → (ℤ/2^{s+1})^× (h₂ the proof `Parameters.two_pow_dvd_N₁` of 2^{s+1} ∣ N₁(P, s)): for all natural numbers i, j with 0 < i < j ≤ 324·s and all σ, τ, ρ ∈ thick, φ(τ/σ)^j = φ(ρ/σ)^i implies φ(τ/σ) = 1; (g_prime) g(i) is prime for i = 0, 1; (g_modEq_one) g(i) ≡ 1 mod N₁(P, s)·d(P); (dvd_g_sub_one) Mω(P, s)² divides g(i) − 1 (natural subtraction); (g_injective) g is injective, i.e. g(0) ≠ g(1); (g_mem) (e^{logB})¹⁰ ≤ g(i) ≤ (e^{logB})¹¹; (norm_piG) piG·conj(piG) = g(0)·g(1) in the ring of integers of K; (exists_prime_window) for every real U with 100·logB ≤ U ≤ 2^s there is a prime p with p ≡ 1 mod Mω(P, s)² and U ≤ log p ≤ U + √logB.

class HasLogBound (D : Data P) (u : Bool) F (l :
  outParam ℝ) where out : ite u (|F| ≤ exp l) (exp l ≤ F)

For parameters P, admissible data D over P, a Boolean u, a real number F and a real number l (an output parameter: instance search computes it from the shape of F), HasLogBound(D, u, F, l) is the proposition (its only field `out`) that |F| ≤ exp(l) if u is true and exp(l) ≤ F if u is false.
